description: FAO's WaPOR portal provides remotely sensed water-productivity information to support monitoring of agricultural water use and associated water-resource planning. The metadata is published or maintained by FAO. FAO describes global 300 m coverage, 100 m coverage in Africa and the Near East, and selected 20 m irrigation areas. Frequency varies by layer, from daily to annual. The provider landing page describes access to API, Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF material. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): FAO terms: statistical databases fall under the FAO Open Data Licensing Policy and Statistical Databases Terms of Use (licence of this database not named on the pages read). FAO states that the data are openly accessible and that its version 3 API requires no token or credentials. Caveats: Coverage and frequency depend on the layer and version. FAO marks some local products discontinued and documents corrections and re-releases. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support capacity planning. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. Related catalogue context is data-fao-aquastat-main-database. This is a thematic comparison, not a verified software dependency or claim of compatible inputs.
